items.title: The AI Model Tier List
items.summary: A viral model tier list lands the same week that a misread FT chart, AT&T's open-model migration, and a flipped Vercel token graph all point the same direction: the question is no longer simply who has the best model, but how you assemble a stack that routes the right task to the right one — and NVIDIA, quietly, is buying its way into the open half of that future.
